title: Supply Chain Integrity via Vyper
business: Logistics companies managing high-value pharmaceutical shipments.
problem: Complex smart contracts in other languages often hide state-changing logic in modifiers or inheritance, leading to opaque audit trails and potential security vulnerabilities during transit verification.
solution: Vyper enforces strict readability and security by design, requiring all logic to be explicit and inline, which ensures that every state change in the shipment lifecycle is immediately visible to auditors.
steps: Define the shipment state using strong typing for timestamps and location coordinates.
Implement explicit assertion checks for temperature thresholds instead of using hidden modifiers.
Utilize pure functions for calculating transit duration to ensure no unintended state modifications occur.
Deploy the contract to the EVM, relying on Vyper's bounds checking to prevent arithmetic overflows.
outcome: A highly transparent and auditable contract structure that minimizes the risk of hidden logic flaws, ensuring stakeholders can verify shipment integrity without navigating complex inheritance trees.
limitation: The absence of recursive calling and infinite-length loops means developers must manually calculate gas limits for all operations; this is checked by ensuring all loops have a fixed, known upper bound.
